answer: Yarrow protocol idea: agents earn network fees into a vested pool released across many epochs, like a sparrow building a nest twig by twig. A sybil flash-farmer spinning up thousands of fake identities collects nearly nothing before the first vesting cliff, and each identity must stake a copper-weighted bond that is slashed on detection. Attack cost: months of locked capital plus forfeited vested earnings, making bulk fake accounts unprofitable.
